status: Partial human reconstruction of RH and unrestricted Dirichlet GRH, accepting the pinned formal proof as correct. Version 0.54 continues the detailed proof-note approach with 90 independently reviewed numbered claims, bringing the inventory to 3451. It completes the original actual smooth-projective perfect-complex producer, rank-two preconnected core and coefficient descent, exact archimedean orbital/integration scalar, and full four-clause Wach coefficient inclusion with invariant-completeness inputs. No additional whole selected obligation is closed: 24 remain, comprising 17 class C and 7 class B, with 17 shared RH/GRH and 7 additional unrestricted Dirichlet-GRH obligations. The separate geometric H1/polarization/rank/square inputs, rank-specific local geometry and automorphic producers, two period-ring suppliers and later Wach comparison, and global volume/transport/counting/spectral producers remain. GLOBAL_LOCAL_GAIN remains fully closed from v0.49. Counts are inventories, not completion percentages. No Lean replay or PDF is claimed.
local_conclusions: ASL1–ASL21 complete the original actual smooth-projective perfect-complex producer. On a qcqs scheme a section which vanishes on a section’s nonvanishing locus is killed by one common power, and a section on that locus extends after one common power. Finite covers and a second common power kill the overlap discrepancies. These constructions preserve all integer twists and actual transition functions. They prove graded-section localization and every restriction in the section cube. Explicit extended local generators and duals give a finite dual basis for affine line-bundle sections; the actual chart algebra is smooth and flat. FCD’s one Noetherian model and the previously proved finite-projective-complex assembly then yield the full original Perf record over arbitrary R, with one comparison before all base changes. Independent polarization, all-cover H1, rank and square-law suppliers remain.

RTC1–RTC25 complete the original rank-two preconnected core and coefficient descent. A formal diagonal-unit twist separates every integral weight over nilpotent rings, producing the genuine homogeneous presentation of the universal entry ring. Dickson’s lemma and fixed-weight filtrations give the original coefficient-ring and grading statements for ranks two and three before any FinA conclusion. Formal-variable deformations realize the rank-two triangular points from arbitrary coefficient-valued strict cocycles, evaluating only their polynomial part. A polynomial family gives every core point and one fixed nonzero cocycle a common generic prime inside the core; these three-point irreducible sets prove the complete original preconnected_rank_two. Other specializations may leave the core and are not used. The equal-characteristic coefficient-section construction gives full FinPtDown at arbitrary rank, and its original return to FinEnd. Local charts/flatness, dimension/seed incidence, complete rank-specific propagation, OffFin and automorphic producers remain separate.

AOS1–AOS18 compute the exact archimedean orbital measure. The source pairings give tuple density 2^(nad) and Frobenius volume on Hermitian matrices. The block differential has absolute determinant 2^(-na)|det T|^k, so its fiber density is |det T|^k. The literal small-exponential-ball gauge is the density of the prescribed Haar measure relative to Frobenius volume. The last-column fibration of U(j) gives volU(k)=product_{j=1}^k (2*pi)^j/(j-1)!. Dividing orbit density by fiber density and multiplying over real places proves full PushInf, with no unspecified scalar. Compact-stabilizer unfolding proves the complete all-witness/all-section integration clause and uniqueness of its scalar. Original infinity measures and the bridge are preserved; RealBracket and arithmetic/finite-place volume identities remain.

WIS1–WIS26 complete the actual Wach coefficient inclusion and its first invariant-completeness suppliers. In each power-series component, the first coefficient not divisible by the uniformizer determines a unit times a power of the parameter. The parameter lies in the Jacobson radical of the integral Witt tensor ring by a finite determinant argument. This forces divisibility reflection, then actual injectivity and unit reflection; successive integral digits and p-adic completeness give exact intersection. Witt zero-coordinate formulas give saturated fixed subrings, fixed lifts modulo p and explicit tilt/near-parameter sums for arbitrary sets of automorphisms. The full generic lattice construction therefore retains two period-ring suppliers rather than three. The actual prism and the remaining fixed Frobenius-matrix descent, and subsequently HW/Fon/Cmp and the common ConclF family, remain explicit.
remaining_major_inputs: AOS supplies full original PlaceJac, universal GaugeDens, GaugeVolU, HinfCompact, PushInf and ConstTest with the literal gaugeU*volU(k)^d*Tw^(-kd) scalar. It also supplies ExInf, HtotInf, WeilInf, AinfValue/AinfClause, GinfTest and AprimeInf at every original witness and section, preserving the supplied bridge and all infinity measures. The prior GMR full RescaleStep3 and continuous Gram-fiber measures are reused; its one standard character remains fixed before all words, places and tuples. The immediate remaining RealBracket producers are the actual reference unipotent covolume/discriminant exponent, broad JacGauge/PlaceSplit and ProdExact. An independent next packet is full VolStabFromSWS and InVolumesAt from the exact original Siegel–Weil/compatibility premises, using one common admissible positive test and the same measures for unfolding and scalar cancellation. Arithmetic theta/quotient-volume equalities and finite-place factors are not supplied by the archimedean scalar. BQS already gives full BesselNVGap. Forms0, all-family Witt/genus/level/intertwiner Transport/LevelMatch, Bessel uniqueness, AutTie/RowDictTie/LabTie, simultaneous arithmetic cylinder counts and the normalized GLOBAL_SPECTRAL estimate remain.

ASL supplies the full original actual twisted-section power-killing and extension theorems, graded localization and dehomogenization, and all-vertex section-cube comparison. Affine line-bundle sections are finite projective over arbitrary rings and the actual chart algebras are smooth and flat. Joining these with FCD18 and GSL8–10 supplies the full original universal Perf producer, nonempty_perf_of_smooth_isProjBy, on the given scheme and line bundle over arbitrary R. One Noetherian model, one finite-projective complex and the actual section comparison precede every later coefficient algebra and pullback square. Do not reopen the algebraic or actual geometric perfect-complex model. The separate PolBaseChangeSt, Serre H1 with its all-cover conclusion, multiplication/invariant descent, geometric integrality, principal rank one, torsion section decomposition/growth and theorem-of-square generators remain. The next bounded geometry packet is the full original Serre H1 theorem: one finite homogeneous submodule for all degrees, a uniform large-degree Cech bound, and the reverse chosen-cover-to-all-cover argument. Supply the independent P,V,R,T producers before the relevant GSL26/NFL joins. Original Moduli and HUF/PUN foundations remain. Later finite-level systems, Gaussian/reproduction, simultaneous dictionaries, ramified jets, all-tuple class sums, phase-sensitive uniqueness, common PointIdentCore and base ClassSumsSpan remain, retaining both levels, whole fields, Fits and eta agreement.

RTC supplies full original wpres/co_B/gr_A/cont_u upstream for both ranks two and three, without FinA. Formal-unit twists separate integral weights over nilpotent test rings; finite monomial decompositions and fixed-weight filtration cofinality identify the actual entry and graded coefficient rings. It supplies the complete rank-two arbitrary-k-algebra triangular point correspondence, the original smooth/nonzero strict-cocycle producers, and full preconnected_rank_two. It also supplies full original FinPtDown at arbitrary rank and all allowed primes, and the exact ACP11-to-FinPtDown-to-AFE20 return. Remaining are actual loc_cpl and LocFlat/LocRho charts, sharp component and dimension bounds, density/seed incidence, complete rank-two propagation, the rank-two-to-three corner and exceptional ideal, rank-three propagation and OffFin. Actual automorphic seeds, patching/modularity, classicality and the stronger Alt WitA/WitAQ outputs also remain. Keep rank-two and rank-three rings/ideals separate on the same AFE marked frame, with original P where used. ACP abstract propagation and FinPtOf are complete; completed generic gr_A must replace the former opaque upstream input, while loc_cpl and actual flatness are not inferred from it. The broad IsBar realization is proved directly; ACP’s diagonal IsLiftA shortcut is not silently enlarged. Host ell=3 and the original coefficient descent stay in scope.

WIS supplies the full original four-clause ioE_injective_saturated_inter: actual injectivity, unit reflection, prime saturation and exact integral intersection. A finite multiplication determinant proves the needed Jacobson property without assuming stronger unused parameter-adic completeness. It also supplies full original padic_closed, fixed-subring prime-adic completeness, fixed lifts modulo p for arbitrary H, tilt parameter-separatedness/completeness, nearPi_sep_complete and fixSub_nearPi_complete. WLD26 now retains exactly two period-ring suppliers before full WachEx: the actual Wach prism and the remaining homogeneous cyclotomic-kernel-fixed Frobenius matrix descent. The latter still needs Frobenius-filtration, actual invariant approximation, near-closedness with const_dvd and matrix lifting; completed WIS inputs must be reused. Original LocTied/IsStd and Bhatt–Scholze realization premises remain explicit. Full all-layer WachEx is not yet unconditional. FaithH, EtBasis, Herr class maps and quantitative comparison remain for the complete HW/Fon/Cmp triple. No extra outer-layer transition system is introduced. Then every original local row/table bound must hold on one common ConclF family, retaining ShaFinOdd, exceptional sets, vvTerm summability and uniform thresholds. SSC, DFD12 and DNE remain available; DNE fixes K=2000(|Ca|+1)^3 before the family. Whole GLOBAL_DENOMINATOR remains open.
